R0264.title: Full-Truckload Capacity Falsification
R0264.definition: In full-truckload scenarios, falsifying vehicle type, trips, or channels to fraudulently claim freight, subsidies, and billing differentials.
R0264.description:
Full-truckload capacity falsification exploits FTL capacity scenarios by falsifying vehicle type, trips, or hijacking legitimate FTL channels to claim freight, subsidies, and billing differentials, often involving driver, site, or partner collusion.

The risk causes inflated freight and subsidy expenditure and distorts capacity dispatch and billing data. Detection must combine vehicle-trip-channel verification, tamper-proofing, and linkage analysis to verify and trace abnormal FTL capacity.
R0264.influence: FTL capacity falsification causes inflated freight and subsidy expenditure, distorts capacity and billing data, and may mask capacity violations.

references.title: Jiaozhou Freight Platform Fraud: 8 Sentenced (Sina, FTL Capacity-Falsification Fraud)

observables: Vehicle type, trip count, or lane is falsely reported in full-truckload capacity scenarios
Shipping fees and subsidies show inflated payouts in full-truckload scenarios
Vehicle-type/trip-count/lane verification mismatches reality
Anomalous full-truckload capacity concentrates on driver, station, or partner collusion
Full-truckload capacity dispatch and billing data are distorted

R0264-001.title: One-Vehicle-Multi-Type Fee Fraud
R0264-001.definition: Registering multiple vehicle types for one vehicle to fraudulently claim freight differentials and multi-type settlement.
R0264-001.description:
One-vehicle-multi-type fee fraud registers multiple vehicle types for the same vehicle, settling by higher-rate types or duplicate-settling across types to claim freight differentials, a vehicle-type variant of FTL capacity falsification.

The risk causes freight-differential expenditure from type mismatch. Detection must combine one-vehicle-one-type verification, type tamper-proofing, and abnormal settlement monitoring.
R0264-001.influence: The risk causes freight-differential and duplicate multi-type settlement expenditure, distorting vehicle-type and capacity data.

references.title: Jiaozhou freight-platform fraud case: 8 sentenced (Sina, FTL capacity fraud)
First nationwide cross-domain routine-hauling fraud case sentenced (People's Daily Online Sichuan, freight capacity-fraud case)
First nationwide cross-domain routine-hauling fraud case sentenced in Sichuan (Sichuan Provincial Department of Transport, freight fee-fraud criminal case)

observables: The same vehicle is registered with multiple vehicle types in the system
High-tariff vehicle-type settlement or duplicate multi-type settlement produces freight differences
Vehicle-to-vehicle-type one-to-one verification fails but is not blocked
Missing vehicle-type tamper protection makes one-vehicle-multiple-types operable
Abnormal settlement clusters on specific vehicle and vehicle-type combinations

R0264-002.title: Jingyi FTL Channel Hijacking
R0264-002.definition: Hijacking the legitimate Jingyi full-truckload channel to impersonate FTL capacity and claim freight and benefits.
R0264-002.description:
Jingyi FTL channel hijacking refers to hijacking the qualification or waybills of Jingyi FTL (JD Logistics' legitimate FTL product) to impersonate FTL capacity for orders, claiming FTL freight, subsidies, and benefits, a channel variant of FTL capacity falsification.

The risk causes freight and benefit losses from hijacked channel qualification and may affect FTL fulfillment quality. Detection must combine channel qualification verification, waybill-vehicle linkage, and abnormal channel monitoring.
R0264-002.influence: The risk causes inflated freight and benefit expenditure, undermines legitimate channel qualification management, and may affect FTL fulfillment quality.

references.title: Jiaozhou Freight Platform Fraud: 8 Sentenced (Sina, FTL Capacity-Falsification Fraud)

observables: Legitimate channel qualifications or waybills of the Jingyi full-truckload channel are abused
Non-full-truckload capacity impersonates full-truckload capacity to take orders and siphon freight and benefits
Channel qualification verification and waybill-vehicle linkage show inconsistencies
Abnormal channel usage clusters on specific partners or drivers
Full-truckload fulfillment quality degrades in channel-abuse scenarios

R0264-003.title: Fake Trip Fee Fraud
R0264-003.definition: Fabricating or duplicate-entering trip records to fraudulently claim freight and subsidies as a fee-fraud scheme.
R0264-003.description:
Fake trip fee fraud fabricates or duplicate-enters trip records, inflating trip counts and mileage to claim freight and subsidies, a trip variant of FTL capacity falsification.

The risk causes inflated trip freight and subsidy expenditure. Detection must combine trip-vehicle-trajectory linkage verification, trip tamper-proofing, and abnormal trip monitoring.
R0264-003.influence: The risk causes inflated freight and subsidy expenditure, distorting trip and capacity data.

references.title: Jiaozhou Freight Platform Fraud: 8 Sentenced (Sina, FTL Capacity-Falsification Fraud)

observables: Trip records are forged or duplicated to inflate trip counts and mileage
Trip-vehicle-trajectory linkage verification shows inconsistencies
Fraudulent trips come with inflated freight and subsidy expenditures
Trip tamper protection is missing or bypassed
Abnormal trips cluster on specific drivers or network points
